name: Soldier of Fortune II: Double Helix
description: Soldier of Fortune II: Double Helix is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game and the second in the Soldier of Fortune series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Soldier of Fortune II plays its sound through snd_dsx86.dll out of the box, which has no EAX — only snd_alx86.dll does.

notes: Only single-player has EAX — multiplayer (SoF2MP.exe) has none.
